description_en: Modifies the severity level of an alert
kebab_example: aliyun arms change-alarm-severity --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --alarm-id 184723093 --severity P1 --handler-id 2046076 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeAlarmSeverity

parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en: The severity level of the alert. Valid values: P1, P2, P3, and P4. P4 indicates the lowest severity, whereas P1 indicates the highest severity.
